name: EPIC 220456059
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 13.4 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,193 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.84 solar masses and 13.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,558 K at its surface.
